variant.displayName: Orange Level Contract: Protect Our Client’s Interests
variant.briefing:
The folks at [DefendLocationWrapperLocation] are under attack and need our support. Their ships in the wider area are being targeted and there’s a growing concern that this is only a precursor to something bigger.  

The situation is evolving, but I’m being fed constant updates on what’s going on and will keep you informed as the contract progresses. 

Are you available to come to their aid? Would be smart to recruit some friends to help. These are important clients and we can’t afford to fail them. The main contractor will earn a bonus payment of [ScripAmount] MG Scrip if you get the job done.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
